_comment: Synthetic but schema-accurate replay of one `lpe manifest propose "freight brokerages, DFW"` run, shaped like the Agent SDK's message stream (assistant tool_use -> user tool_result -> ... -> result). No keys, no live call. It deliberately contains four fields the citation gate must drop: a source cited only from a search result, a rule with no citation, a predicate rule the schema refuses, and a signal citing a fetch that errored.

content.text: I'll find the regulator of record for freight brokers first.

input.query: authoritative registry of licensed freight brokers United States

content.content: Web search results: 1. FMCSA - Get Operating Authority (MC Number) https://www.fmcsa.dot.gov/registration/get-mc-number-authority-operate 2. FMCSA Company Census File https://ai.fmcsa.dot.gov/SMS/Tools/Downloads.aspx 3. DAT Load Board directory https://www.dat.com/load-boards

input.prompt: Who must obtain broker operating authority, and what records does FMCSA keep?
What does the census file contain and how is it published?

content.content: Brokers arranging transportation of regulated commodities for compensation must obtain broker operating authority (an MC number) and file a BOC-3 and a surety bond (BMC-84/85). FMCSA revokes authority that lapses.
The Company Census File lists every registered entity with its USDOT number, physical address, carrier operation, number of power units and drivers. Published monthly as a downloadable dataset.

input.prompt: Which fields distinguish a carrier from a broker?
Which TMS do small brokerages use?
Describe the daily work and typical employer size of freight agents.

content.content: The snapshot shows Entity Type (CARRIER, BROKER), Operating Authority Status, Power Units and Drivers. An entity with power units operates its own equipment.

Cargo and freight agents arrange shipments, track loads and lanes, collect carrier packets and certificates of insurance (COIs), make check calls and handle detention claims. Most work in offices of freight brokerages and 3PLs.

content.text: I have enough to propose the manifest.
